meta.idAlgorithm: id = 'LL-' + sha256(ruleKey + '|' + path) first 10 hex chars; stable across runs so recurrence is a diff
meta.governance: Only Scot closes a finding, downgrades severity, accepts risk, or sets a disposition (accepted/fixed/dismissed-false-positive/wontfix). closureEvidence.attestation and disposition.decidedBy stay empty until Scot signs. Findings are added mechanically (scripts/audit-merge.rb from /audit-run, scripts/promote-finding.rb from PR-time reviews) and only ever land as status 'open' with disposition 'untriaged'; the adding scripts never close, downgrade, or triage. No student/patient data ever appears here; evidence snippets are code only and any PII/secret-bearing finding is refused at promotion, never redacted-in.
meta.disposition: Optional per-finding triage state, orthogonal to status. status answers 'does the issue still exist in code' (lifecycle, citation-validated); disposition answers 'what did we decide to do about it' (untriaged/accepted/fixed/dismissed-false-positive/wontfix). A finding with no disposition object is treated as untriaged. Set only by Scot.
